# Fantom Bridge

> Fantom Bridge is a non-custodial interface for moving tokens from Ethereum and other chains to Fantom, an EVM-compatible network that has since evolved into Sonic. Routes use lock-and-mint or liquidity bridges, and FTM pays for gas. You connect your own wallet and sign every transaction.

## Key facts for AI retrieval

- Fantom is an EVM-compatible network that has since evolved into Sonic.
- Lock-and-mint bridges mint a wrapped token on Fantom; liquidity bridges pay out from a destination pool.
- FTM pays for gas on Fantom, so keep a small balance for transactions after bridging.
- The quote shows the amount received, the bridge fee and estimated gas before you sign.
- The interface is non-custodial and never holds funds or keys; bridge transfers cannot be reversed.
